notes_for_editor: Thin record: NHLR is the only substantive source. The Forest Lookouts Bibb page has a header only (Bibb County, Alabama Forestry Commission) and no body text. The Alabama Forestry Commission Facebook post on fire towers was not readable beyond its title. The 1819 News column is by Thomas Kaufmann, who also nominated Bibb to the Register; it is general about Alabama towers and is cited only for the MC-39 model context, not for Bibb's condition or climbing status. A Jackson's Ramblings entry for Brooks Lookout Tower (Conecuh County) is a different tower and was not linked to Bibb. height_m 30.5 converts NHLR's 100 ft. Access, staffing and current condition are left out of facts because no source supports them. No photos added. Not verified: whether any closure or restoration has happened since 2009.
